title: B-24H Liberator USAAF Crew Tablet
memorial_details: description: Remember before God with thanksgiving/ the gallant Crew of B24H 'Alfred' of the 392nd BG. USAAF/ which crashed near this spot on 4th January 1944/ whilst returning badly damaged from a mission to Kiel./ In gratitude also to those who aided the survivors/ in the common cause of freedom./ (Names)/ LEST WE FORGET
